name: Komiya Takahisa
source:
Age 27. The protagonist of this story --- that is, you.  You are an elite employee of a major publishing company and are entrusted with many big projects at a young age. 

He has a serious work ethic, is trusted by his superiors, and handles difficult tasks with ease. He is a refreshingly handsome man with long legs and a well-proportioned, smart figure. 

He is highly conscious and values social justice, and secretly despises people like Haramura who do not have an updated sense of values.  

He also believes that he must protect Sakura, who is unaware that she is being sexually harassed and who unconsciously says and does things to make her husband feel better. 

He truly loves his wife, Sakura. He believes that his love for her is not based on her appearance, but on his respect for her inner beauty.

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf015/character.html]official site[/url]]
